name: hy3131_poll
comment: Polls PF3 (HY3131 DO = IRQ while CS high); runs hy3131_service

name: hy3131_service
comment: Reads regs 0x00-0x33, clears INTF, dispatches AD1/RMS/peak/counter handlers

name: calibrate_zero_and_gain
comment: averages 16 samples, derives offset and gain, stores calibration

name: rotary_pins_config
comment: fallback pin mask comes from caller's r2

name: g_counter_preset
comment: u32, default 0xE000; preset written to CTA

name: g_cfg_022e
comment: u16 setting, default 500; role unknown (key timing)

name: g_apo_seconds_left
comment: Auto power-off countdown (beeps at 60 s, off at 0)

name: g_autohold_mode
comment: selects partial LCD updates; role unknown
